notes: Diagnosis: dense refits (28 lags, same 16-rev window) put the least residual exactly on the true lag for 40/50/90 ms builds, so the bias was survey_pick's three-point parabola on a lopsided V. Design (70 stored drills): natural cubic spline through all 7 sums on log(lag+10 ms) 68/70 within 5% vs parabola 41/70; alternatives (other axes, 4-pt cubic, regridding, grid search) scored lower or overfit. Pre-registered held-out (commit 3de646cbe; 44 fresh drills, ESC 25-270 ms, lags 0.45/0.65 s, seed 13, launcher 1): spline 39/44 within 5% vs 27, 42 vs 40 within 15%, max equal (48.1%, two 270 ms drills at the 400 ms grid end). Rule met, ESC_SURVEY_SPLINE=True. One prediction clause failed (parabola's 25-75 ms mean signed error was +2.0%, not below -4%), reported in README, eval and post. Verification: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots (see PR).
